title: Introduce credential fallback registries and pullstream sugar across SDK trio
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Add CredentialRegistry (fallthrough credential sources) and a lightweight PullStream.simplify() helper across Python/TS/Go SDKs. No behavioral breaking changes; opt-in ergonomics improvements and a minor SDK version bump.
description: Context: Multiple teams reported fragile credential fallbacks and repeated boilerplate when wiring streaming consumers with refreshable tokens. The SDKs had asymmetrical helper surfaces which made cross-language parity and onboarding harder. Goal: Provide a small, well-documented credential registry abstraction (CredentialRegistry) that composes sources (env, file, delegated, cache) with deterministic fallthrough semantics, plus a tiny ergonomic helper PullStream.simplify() that normalizes async/pull streaming patterns across Python/TS/Go. This PR implements the registry and helpers in all three SDKs, updates tests and docs, and bumps SDK patch versions. Changes here are intentionally additive and opt-in.
commits: feat(python): add CredentialRegistry + docs and unit tests
feat(ts): credential registry + PullStream.simplify() and example
feat(go): registry with delegate adapter and test coverage
chore: sync sdk docs and bump versions (py 0.23.1, ts 1.8.4, go 0.9.2)
test: add cross-sdk integration fixture for short-lived token rotation

merge_commit_summary: squash: introduce CredentialRegistry and PullStream.simplify across SDKs; add tests, docs and examples; bump SDK patch versions
notes: Migration: no mandatory code changes for existing users. Teams can opt into CredentialRegistry by importing and composing sources. The docs include a small migration recipe for teams that previously scattered credential logic across app bootstrapping. Monitoring: added a telemetry event when the registry falls through more than one source in a single lifetime (helps detect misconfigurations).
